	The Risk and Credit Officer will be responsible for supporting effective credit administration, risk assessment, loan monitoring, and recovery while ensuring compliance with the organization&rsquo;s policies and applicable regulatory standards.
	The ideal candidate should be analytical, accountable, trustworthy, and capable of safeguarding the organization&rsquo;s financial assets and reputation.

	Possess proven integrity and a strong sense of accountability.
	Have a sound educational background.
	Have practical experience in credit administration and risk management.
	Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Have good knowledge of microfinance operations.
	Be able to evaluate and assess credit/loan applications.
	Monitor loan performance and identify potential risks.
	Have experience or competence in loan recovery and follow-up.
	Ensure compliance with institutional policies and regulatory requirements.
	Demonstrate leadership capacity and sound decision-making skills.
	Be committed to protecting the organization&rsquo;s assets and reputation.


Preferred Candidate Profile:


	Interested candidates should possess an HND with at least 2 years of experience.&nbsp;
	Candidates with relevant experience in microfinance, credit administration, loan
	management, risk management, banking, or financial services are preferred.


Remuneration


	Salary: N90,000 per month for the first 3 months
	Confirmation Salary: N120,000 per month, with additional incentives upon confirmation.
	Probation Salary: N90,000 per month for the first 3 months


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and application &nbsp;to: pixelpulseviralchemy@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

        Pixelpulse Viralchemy is a company whose services range from recruitment to advertising, sales, branding & PR.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Risk and Credit Officer
Job Location: 433 Kala Plaza, Rumuokwuta, Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Start Date: Immediate
Work Schedule Days / hours: Monday – Friday (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM)

Job Description

	The Risk and Credit Officer will be responsible for supporting effective credit administration, risk assessment, loan monitoring, and recovery while ensuring compliance with the organization’s policies and applicable regulatory standards.
	The ideal candidate should be analytical, accountable, trustworthy, and capable of safeguarding the organization’s financial assets and reputation.


Requirements
The ideal candidate should:


	Possess proven integrity and a strong sense of accountability.
	Have a sound educational background.
	Have practical experience in credit administration and risk management.
	Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Have good knowledge of microfinance operations.
	Be able to evaluate and assess credit/loan applications.
	Monitor loan performance and identify potential risks.
	Have experience or competence in loan recovery and follow-up.
	Ensure compliance with institutional policies and regulatory requirements.
	Demonstrate leadership capacity and sound decision-making skills.

	Interested candidates should possess an HND with at least 2 years of experience.

Accountant Job at Glorisco Enterprises Nigeria




        
    

        
        Glorisco Enterprises Nigeria is a retail chain that specializes in outright sales and supplies of consumer goods and services to customers through multiple chains of distribution.

As a fast-growing, thriving and dynamic company, we consistently and sustainably strive to satisfy the ever increasing customer demands identified through a well streamlined supply chain.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Accountant
Job Location: Owerri, Imo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Maintain accurate financial records and accounts
	Record daily sales, expenses, purchases, and payments
	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports
	Reconcile cash, bank, and POS transactions
	Monitor income and expenditure
	Manage invoices, receipts, and other financial documents
	Assist with payroll and other accounting duties
	Monitor inventory-related financial records
	Ensure proper documentation and accountability of funds
	Assist management with financial analysis and decision-making


Requirements


	HND / B.Sc. in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
	Previous accounting experience, preferably in a supermarket or retail environment
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software
	Strong numerical and analytical skills
	Excellent attention to detail and record-keeping ability
	Honesty, integrity, and accountability
	Ability to work independently and meet deadline.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and application to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

	Participate in multiple and simultaneous risk
	Contribute to internal departmental initiatives such as training, departmental development initiatives and other internal projects as requested.
	Effectively discuss audit issues and develop business focused controls recommendations to strengthen control lapses and weaknesses-based audit while maintaining departmental quality standards. Function as part of a team or work independently when required.


Job Requirements
Education:


	University: First Degree(s) in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Related field.
	Others: Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor or related professional certifications would be an added advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 10 years of experience in IT Auditing or a similar role.

Head, IT Audit Job at Unified Payment Services Limited




        
    

        
        Unified Payment Services Limited is a group of companies with services including Banking, Payment Scheme, Financial Technology, Digital Commerce, Value Added Service, Payment Solutions, Software Solutions, etc. Unified Payments is a principal member or licensed acquirer of American Express, Mastercard, Visa and UnionPay; and has been instrumental in building the infrastructure that supports Nigeria’s modern payments ecosystem.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Head, IT Audit

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Objectives
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	To provide independent assurance to management on IT General Controls.
	Ensure best assurance practice in the plan and execution of IS Audit Programs.
	Ensure enterprise wide compliance of business processes and operations to internal policies, procedures and documentations.
	Incorporation of standard practices, principles and processes into audit programs and execution.
	Review of risk related control issues and draft appriopriate remediation plans.
	Understand the business environment and develop relationships with audit client in providing value added solutions and best practices implementation.


Duties & Responsibilities


	Audit Review of Database Management Systems, Enterprise Network security and Device configuration, Antivirus, Systems Patches and Log Management.
	Audit Review of Software Development Life Cycle, Project Management Implementation and Change Management Procedures.
	Audit Review of Data Encryption Processes, Key Management Lifecycle, and Operating Systems, physical and logical security of card holder environment.
	Audit Review of Active Directory, Operating Systems, Data backup and tape management.
	Assess systems and general IT controls and provide practical and Value-added remediation plans.
	Prepare audit reports that summarize the most significant control weaknesses and resulting impact to the organization.
	Participate in multiple and simultaneous risk
	Contribute to internal departmental initiatives such as training, departmental development initiatives and other internal projects as requested.
	Effectively discuss audit issues and develop business focused controls recommendations to strengthen control lapses and weaknesses-based audit while maintaining departmental quality standards. Function as part of a team or work independently when required.


Job Requirements
Education:


	University: First Degree(s) in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Related field.
	Others: Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor or related professional certifications would be an added advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 10 years of experience in IT Auditing or a similar role.
	Understanding of the key technology and general controls around enterprise Applications and information systems.
